title: An executive chairman adds a job to his own role — 'ser el que recuerda para qué empezamos'
summary: Suite SIDOM is almost twenty years old. La Rosa Pedernera reads financial gravity as a design problem rather than a failure of people, and now asks two questions before any large decision: whether they would take it if no one measured the quarter, and what they will not trade away.
blockquote:
Cuando pasé a Executive Chairman pensé que mi trabajo iba a ser, sobre todo, mirar la estrategia. 
Leyendo a Ries sumé otra tarea: ser el que recuerda para qué empezamos.
blockquote_source: Santiago La Rosa Pedernera on LinkedIn
